metadata.description: Non-authoritative functional hints for finding the public authority likely to hold requested records. These are not PIO directories or jurisdiction determinations.
metadata.official_framework_source: The Right to Information Act, 2005, sections 6 and 7

records.likely_authority: The local body, State public works/roads authority, highway authority, or other public authority that controls the specified road
records.reason: Road ownership varies between municipal, panchayat, State and Central bodies, so the location and road type are needed before selecting an office.
record_requests: Provide copies of the current file noting, inspection records and action-taken records concerning repair or maintenance of the specified road for {date_range}.
Provide copies of sanctioned estimates, administrative or technical approvals, work orders and tender/contract records for the specified work, where held.
Provide records showing amounts sanctioned, amounts paid, contractor or executing-agency details, and the recorded completion status.
Provide copies of complaints received about this location and the action recorded on each complaint for {date_range}.
Provide the name and designation of the office responsible for maintenance of this road as recorded by the public authority.

records.likely_authority: The municipal, panchayat, sanitation, sewerage, or other local public authority responsible for the service at the specified location
records.reason: Local-service responsibility depends on whether the area is governed by a municipality, corporation, panchayat, utility, or another agency.
record_requests: Provide the service schedule, duty roster or applicable service standard for {issue} at {location} for {date_range}.
Provide copies of complaints, inspection reports and action-taken entries relating to this issue for {date_range}.
Provide copies of work orders or contracts for the relevant service at this location, including the executing agency and contract period, where held.
Provide records showing the office and designation responsible for monitoring this service at the specified location.

records.likely_authority: The local body, public water utility, public health engineering department, or other authority responsible for the specified supply
records.reason: Water-service control differs by State and local utility arrangement.
record_requests: Provide records of supply schedules, interruptions and restoration action for {location} during {date_range}.
Provide copies of water-quality test reports for the relevant supply zone during {date_range}, where available.
Provide copies of complaints, inspection records, repair work orders and action-taken records concerning the stated issue.
Provide records identifying the office responsible for operation and maintenance of this supply.

records.likely_authority: The State/UT food and civil-supplies or public-distribution authority responsible for the ration card or fair-price shop
records.reason: Public-distribution administration and record custody are State/UT and locality specific.
record_requests: Provide the recorded status and processing history of the specified ration-card or public-distribution matter.
Provide copies of allocation, stock, distribution and inspection records for the identified fair-price shop for {date_range}, where relevant.
Provide copies of complaints and action-taken records relating to the identified shop or application for {date_range}.
Provide the name and designation of the office responsible for the relevant record or service.

records.authority_type: Police public authority holding the administrative record
records.likely_authority: The police unit or supervisory public authority that holds the requested administrative record
records.reason: The correct unit depends on the police station, district/commissionerate and record requested; disclosure may also be subject to statutory exemptions.
record_requests: Provide the diary, receipt or registration particulars recorded for the specified complaint or representation.
Provide copies of administrative forwarding and action-taken records on the complaint for {date_range}, subject to applicable exemptions.
Provide the recorded designation of the officer or unit currently responsible for the matter.
If any requested material is withheld, provide the decision identifying the statutory provision relied upon for withholding it.

records.authority_type: Government education authority or public educational institution
records.likely_authority: The government institution, local education office, State/UT education authority, or Central education authority that holds the records
records.reason: Record custody depends on whether the institution and programme are local, State/UT, or Central.
record_requests: Provide the recorded status and file movement for the specified application, complaint or service matter.
Provide copies of the applicable selection, allocation or service criteria and the record showing how they were applied in this matter.
Provide copies of relevant inspection reports, attendance or delivery records, orders and action-taken records for {date_range}, where applicable.
Provide records identifying the office responsible for the decision or service.

records.likely_authority: The tehsil/taluk, survey, registration, land-record, revenue, or other State/UT authority holding the specified record
records.reason: Land administration and record names vary by State/UT and district.
record_requests: Provide a copy of the current record and the mutation or change history for the identified property, where the public authority holds it.
Provide the application receipt, file movement, noting and order records for the specified land-record request.
Provide copies of survey, inspection or measurement records connected with the stated matter, where available.
Provide records identifying the office responsible for maintaining and correcting this record.

records.authority_type: Public health institution or health authority
records.likely_authority: The government health institution, district health authority, State/UT health department, or Central authority holding the records
records.reason: Responsibility depends on the institution, programme, and level of government.
record_requests: Provide the recorded status, file movement and action taken on the specified public-health service matter.
Provide copies of the applicable service protocol, duty roster, stock record or inspection record relevant to the issue for {date_range}, where held.
Provide copies of complaints and action-taken records relating to the specified service for {date_range}.
Provide records identifying the office responsible for the relevant service or record.

records.authority_type: Scheme-administering public authority or implementing agency
records.likely_authority: The government department or public implementing agency that processed the identified scheme application or payment
records.reason: The administering authority must be identified from the scheme name, State/UT, application reference and implementing level.
record_requests: Provide the recorded status and complete processing history of the specified application or benefit.
Provide copies of deficiency notices, verification reports, approvals, rejection orders and payment records connected with the application.
Provide the eligibility criteria and operational instructions recorded as applicable to this application on the relevant date.
Provide records identifying the office currently responsible for the pending action, if any.

fallback.authority_type: Public authority holding or controlling the requested record
fallback.likely_authority: Unable to identify without the government service, location, and office involved
fallback.reason: No reliable topic match was found. RTI routing must follow the authority that holds or controls the records, not a guessed topic-to-department mapping.
record_requests: Provide copies of the file, noting, correspondence, orders and action-taken records concerning {issue} for {date_range}.
Provide the recorded status and dates of movement between offices for this matter.
Provide copies of the applicable administrative instructions or service standards used to process this matter.
Provide records identifying the office and designation responsible for the next recorded action.
